grh_a0b97493cede52a74960.title: Old Battle axe
paragraphs: After forty years in the classroom and several serious heart attacks, strict teacher Sarah Adams, known to generations of Rivers End children as 'Old Battle Axe,' retires and insists she never wants to see another child. Needing an inexpensive place to live after leaving the school cottage, she rents a room from Bruce and Jane Crandall, whose five-year-old son David is blind. Sarah immediately begins ordering the household around, correcting grammar, rearranging routines and disciplining David, but beneath the severity she becomes deeply involved in the family's future. She pushes Bruce to seek more education, offers to look after the house and David while his parents work, and quietly forms a powerful attachment to the boy. Christian tells the family that David's clouded corneas might be replaced if suitable healthy corneas become available. A dying man, Sam Dennis, has offered his eyes, but Sarah condemns the idea as interfering with Providence. When Sam dies, his relatives refuse permission and the opportunity is lost. Sarah then suffers another grave attack and understands that she herself is dying. Before her death she makes Christian promise that David will receive her own corneas, formally arranging the gift so no relatives can block it. The woman who had objected to David seeing through another man's eyes ultimately chooses to let him see the world through hers, revealing the love hidden beneath the fearsome reputation of Rivers End's 'Old Battle Axe.'

grh_a062c83bdb439b7ef4ff.title: Two Faces of Evil
paragraphs: Celebrated astronaut Jason Tucker and his clone, Joe Van, fly to the deep-space station Janus II to recover a failed robot computer. Jason believes Joe Van is to remain behind, while Colonel Frank Cain has secretly ordered the clone to strand Jason and return alone. After Joe Van follows that order, Cain claims the clone went rogue and pushes to lead a heroic rescue. Major Stoddard insists on questioning Joe Van, exposing Cain's scheme to recreate an earlier mission failure, vindicate himself, and discredit the clone program. Jason is recovered, Cain is removed for psychiatric examination, and Joe Van recommends Stoddard to lead the program with a better balance of emotion and efficiency.
